rationale: Linfeng Zhao's ML research background at Stanford and Arsen Kostenko's ML infrastructure engineering at Troveo AI represent complementary perspectives on machine learning systems—research rigor paired with production implementation. Arsen's experience across Python, Java, and build systems like Bazel could benefit discussions around operationalizing research, while Linfeng's postdoc work offers theoretical grounding for infrastructure decisions.
intro_message: Linfeng Zhao, meet Arsen Kostenko — you're both working in machine learning from different angles (research at Stanford vs. ML infrastructure at Troveo AI) and could learn from each other's approaches to the problem space.
